chapter: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering
act_title: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering

quests.title: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering

dialogue.t: Oh... thank you, brave Traveler!
Oh, phew! It hasn't been too long and the parts are still in good condition... Just a few more adjustments...

dialogue.sit: Vinayak starts tinkering with the machinery...

dialogue.t: ...Vinayak?
Almost done... I'm almost done!
Vi-na-yak!
Whoa! Shriya? When did you get here?

dialogue.sit: When you were fiddling with the components...

dialogue.t: Didn't you say that this place was dangerous and full of monsters? Why are you even here?
...I'm just worried about our components. If we can't finish this assignment, even I can't return to the Akademiya!
Ha, I knew it. Look, I have everything here. Once we go back and make some more adjustments, we can finally start assembling.
So, what are all these components for?
Ah, I forgot to tell you. They're for the Wenutslayer Cannon, our graduation project.
Why such an obscure topic?
If you'd applied for graduation, you'd understand why... Well, not that any of this matters now.
Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Shriya, an Amurta graduate with a specialization in desert biology and ecology.
This machine-obsessed doofus over here is a Kshahrewar researcher with a specialization in applied mechanics.
...I'm Vinayak. Thanks a lot for earlier.
Can people with completely different fields of study... work together?
Don't get me started... Working with him on our graduation proposal was definitely the biggest mistake I've ever made as a student...
You can't really say that. We both managed to graduate in the end anyway.
We did, yes, but did you forget how many extra years it took?
Whatever the case, we graduated, right? I heard some of our classmates just completed their thesis proposal last year.
Ugh... enough! We're not students anymore, so can we just move on from these pointless discussions?
You're the one who always starts it...
Nonsense! When we were building the first prototype...

dialogue.sit: Arguing isn't gonna get you anywhere.

dialogue.t: Wow... you guys have it out for each other. How could the Akademiya even think of sending you two together to handle this...
*sigh* Actually, the Akademiya didn't send us... A person named Kunar was supposed to take care of this matter.
You could call him my mentor's mentor... He was there during our thesis defense.
I guess that was how he got the impression that "some young students in the Akademiya had designed a Wenutslayer Cannon," or something like that.
So this time, he simply kicked the two of us back here to deal with the problem, saying that "the Akademiya needs to give youngsters more opportunities to shine!"
But he obviously didn't consider the fact that the two of us have barely talked to each other since graduation...
He even convinced my mentor... Ahem, anyway, this is an opportunity for me to get the Wenutslayer Cannon back out in the open!
Once it's assembled, we'll show those vermin what it can do!
There that mechanical idiot goes again... From my point of view, I also want to investigate the cause of the Wenut rampage to maintain the ecological balance of the desert.
Mr.(Ms.) Adventurer, you look like someone of impressive skill. May I ask you to keep us safe while we're in the desert?

dialogue.sit: I'll do it for the right price.
It'll be a walk in a park for me.

dialogue.t: Rest assured. There isn't a lot of support from the Akademiya, but at least we're well-funded. ...Although someone here has spent most of it on upgrading the machinery.
Th—The improvements were necessary! ...And since you're capable of speaking politely, can't you be a little nicer to me?
That depends on whether the person I'm talking to is worthy of my patience!
Oh no... here they go again...

dialogue.sit: Maybe leave the arguing for later?
Can we start with the actual work?

dialogue.t: *sigh* Sorry... It's an old habit from my Akademiya days...
This batch of components has to be brought back to Aaru Village for further adjustment. By all accounts, we can't start assembling until tomorrow.
We had previously planned to install the Wenutslayer Cannon in nearby areas where Wenut have been spotted.
When the time comes, there may be other creatures attracted by the noise we make. We'll be counting on you.
We can continue our debate now, right? I'm telling you, all my expenses are justified.
You...! Fine, you asked for it. Let's go over the details and see where all that Mora went!

quests.description: After running about, you manage to help Vinayak gather the components…
